_comment: Type-checking config. tsconfig.json cannot carry the '*' wildcard:
Next feeds tsconfig paths into webpack and SWC, so mapping every bare
specifier also remaps 'react', bypassing Next's per-layer resolution.
Client components then receive the react-server build and every hook
throws 'Cannot read properties of null' at prerender. The same wildcard
made SWC rewrite @metabuilder/m3 before jest could substitute its mock,
silently rendering real components in 34 tests.
tsc needs it because the sibling repos this app aliases live outside the
project and their upward node_modules walk never reaches ours - without
it, 677 'Cannot find module react' errors from files we do not own.
paths is repeated in full: TypeScript replaces the key wholesale on
